Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: During the H2 & FY26 earnings conference call, Canarys Automations reported its highest-ever financial performance with standalone total income crossing INR101.7 crores and consolidated total income reaching INR199.7 crores. Management highlighted a strategic pivot toward an AI-native engineering platform supported by the proprietary CAR framework and proprietary AI-powered products such as AURYIS, ClubAce, and Scholaris. While consolidated margins were moderated by talent and integration investments including Fortira Inc., the company expects margins and key parameters to improve over the next 12 to 24 months. Furthermore, the total order book stood at approximately INR441 crores, providing revenue visibility for the coming years. Canarys Automations Limited released its investor presentation for FY26, highlighting record-breaking standalone and consolidated financial performances driven by technology solutions, water resource management, and the acquisition of Fortira Inc.

guidance.claim: Management targets an annualized growth of at least 20 percent for revenue while aiming for higher growth.
guidance.quote: It should be. We are targeting a little higher as well. But at a bare minimum, yes, 20% is quite achievable, but we are targeting for higher growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Management describes the order pipeline as pretty strong while working on multiple project opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: Pipeline is pretty strong. We are working on multiple project opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: Customers are asking for quick turnaround because they feel artificial intelligence is the norm.
demand_outlook.quote: A lot of customers are also asking quick turnaround because they all feel that AI is the norm, and we cannot avoid that.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the growth demand for digital transformation is reflected in the successful delivery of 164 projects across various industries.
demand_outlook.quote: We achieved a strong business momentum in H1 FY '26 with a successful delivery of 164 projects across diverse industries such as IT, BFSI, healthcare, logistics, etc., underscoring the growth demand for digital transformation.

capex_expansion.claim: The acquisition of Fortira Inc. in April 2025 strengthened the North American presence.
capex_expansion.quote: The acquisition of Fortira Inc. in April 2025 has been a strong strategic move, strengthening our North American presence with 20-plus enterprise customers and materially expanding our capabilities across AI, cloud, cybersecurity and digital engineering.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired Fortira Inc., USA in April 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: Acquired Fortira Inc., USA in April 2025, significantly strengthening Canarys' presence in the North American technology services market.

capex_expansion.claim: The strategic acquisition of Fortira, a U.S.-based AI, data, digital engineering, and IT consulting firm, was completed in April 2025 for a 51% stake.
capex_expansion.quote: Completed this acquisition in April 2025 for a 51% stake, underscored our transition from a local solutions company to a global, active, innovation-driven technology enterprise.

capex_expansion.claim: Canarys launched AURYIS, its first AI-powered software product for the pharmaceutical and life science sector, on August 20, 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: Advancing our innovation agenda, we launched AURYISon August 20, 2025, our first artificial intelligence-powered software product for the pharmaceutical and life science sector, introduced simultaneously in India and North America.

margins_costs.claim: Agentic AI delivered through the CAR framework has the potential to improve gross margin potential by up to 12 percentage points.
margins_costs.quote: Our assessment shows that Agentic AI delivered through the CAR framework has the potential to improve engineering productivity by up to 5x, increase revenue per employee by more than 40%, improve gross margin potential by up to 12 percentage points and accelerate project delivery by nearly 30%.

margins_costs.claim: Integration costs and talent investments that moderated margins in FY26 are largely onetime in nature.
margins_costs.quote: And third, the integration costs and talent investments that moderated margins in FY26, including the Fortira integration are largely onetime in nature.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone EBITDA margin improved to 17 percent in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA Margin improved to 17% through operational efficiencies, execution excellence, and AI-enabled productivity initiatives.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone profit before tax and exceptional items improved to 16 percent.
margins_costs.quote: Profit Before Tax and Exceptional Items improved to 16%, reflecting strong operational performance.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone PAT growth was affected by a one-time exceptional loss related to labour code provisions.
margins_costs.quote: However, PAT growth was affected by a one-time exceptional loss related to the implementation of labour code provisions.

margins_costs.claim: Strategic growth investments, integration costs, and talent onboarding led to a moderation in consolidated EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: Strategic growth investments, including integration costs and talent onboarding, led to a moderation in EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin for H1 FY26 stood at 13%, which included a slight dip expected due to strategic investments in team expansion, product development, and global scaling.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA stood at INR 13 crores with a 13% margin. There is a slight dip in margin, which was expected as we made strategic investments in team expansion, product development, and global scaling.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for H1 FY26 stood at INR 9 crores, representing a margin of 9%.
margins_costs.quote: Our profit after tax stood at INR 9 crores, reflecting a margin of 9% and demonstrating our ability to sustain healthy profitability while continuing to invest in future growth.

orders_capacity.claim: The total order book stands at approximately INR441 crores, with Technology Solutions contributing INR206 crores, Fortira adding INR207 crores, and Water Resource Management contributing INR28 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book stands at approximately INR441 crores, giving us healthy revenue visibility for the years ahead. Technology Solutions contributes INR206 crores, nearly doubling from INR105 crores in FY '25. Fortira adds INR207 crores and Water Resource Management contributes INR28 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: The total order book stands at INR 208 crores, consisting of INR 151 crores from the technology solutions vertical and INR 57 crores from water resource management.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book now stands at a healthy INR 208 crores, out of which INR 151 crores from technology solutions vertical, a significant rise from INR 105 crores in FY '25, and INR 57 crores from water resource management.

capital_allocation.claim: The debt-to-equity ratio remains low at 0.1x.
capital_allocation.quote: Our debt-to-equity ratio remains very low at 0.1x, underlying our conservative and healthy capital structure.

risks_headwinds.claim: Growth in profit after tax was affected by a onetime exceptional item relating to the implementation of labour code provisions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Profit after tax stood at INR10 crores. Growth here was affected by a onetime exceptional item relating to the implementation of labour code provisions. And excluding that item, our underlying profitability tells an even stronger story.

risks_headwinds.claim: Water resource management projects involve longer payment cycles, leading management to take a more focused approach.
risks_headwinds.quote: These projects have strengthened our expertise, but given longer payment cycles, we now take a more focused approach choosing opportunities that offer speed, scale, and better commercial outcomes.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects margin correction and traction building for Fortira to take 12 to 18 months.
management_commitments.quote: The correction will definitely take about 12 to 18 months. And Fortira has already seen good traction with this.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the business model shift and numbers to show over the next 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: Put simply, we are deliberately pivoting our business model through AI and our product portfolio toward a structurally high margin, more profitable and faster-growing company, and we expect the numbers to show it over the next 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Operational performance is expected to improve as synergies are realized and scale benefits accrue.
management_commitments.quote: However, operational performance is expected to improve as synergies are realized and scale benefits accrue.

management_commitments.claim: One of the key goals for FY26 is to train 25% of the team in AI, ML, and data skills.
management_commitments.quote: One of our key goals for FY '26 is to train 25% of our team in AI, ML, and data skills to strengthen our leadership in emerging technologies.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the first commercial engagement for AURYIS will take another 6 to 8 months.
management_commitments.quote: It will take another at least 6-8 months to start the first commercial engagement.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
